title: Sheinbaum Says Interpol Dropped Red Notices for Gómez Mont and Álvarez Puga; Mocks Calderón Forum
detail: At her Sept 30 morning conference, Sheinbaum said Interpol no longer lists red notices for Inés Gómez Mont and Víctor Manuel Álvarez Puga, and questioned the decision. She also ironically dismissed a Free Americas Forum of Latin American center-right parties to be attended by former president Felipe Calderón. Her government denied that the copyright reform is an 'anti-memes law', and she criticised opaque digital-platform algorithms.
